messages:
rita: quick proposal for postmortem follow-ups: make action owners accountable with lightweight checkpoints (24h, 72h, 14d) + an automatic 'recurrence' marker if the same service appears in >2 PMs in 60d. sharing a short template below.

omar: liking the cadence. small ask: include a required 'acceptance criteria' field so verification isn't vague. also prefer 14d vs 30d for quicker closure.

tia: +1 to acceptance criteria and recurrence marker. can ops-bot send reminders to both owner and their manager at 50% SLO? that helps unblock faster.

ops-bot: i can do that. command: `@ops-bot enable-slo <ticket-id> 50% notify:owner,manager reminders:24h,72h,14d`. need JIRA integration enabled.

rita: template I propose (tiny):
```
PM Followup Checkpoints:
- Owner: @name
- Priority: P1/P2/P3
- Acceptance criteria (link or metric)
- 24h: Status / Blockers / Next action + ETA
- 72h: Status / Progress summary / Risk level
- 14d: Resolution verified? yes/no + evidence link
- Recurrence flag: yes/no + references
```

oncall-lead: rotate IC every 2 weeks, start Mon 09:00 UTC, keep secondary contact for weekends. shorter rotations fragment context. roster published in playbook.

omar: process rule: if owner reports "Blocked" on two consecutive checks, auto-escalate to oncall-lead and open a short companion task to remove the blocker.

tia: analytics ask: surface metrics for "remediations reopened" and "repeat-service count (60d)" on the oncall dashboard. threshold alert when repeat-service >= 3.

rita: i'll draft a PR with template, rotation, and ops-bot commands. @tia can you own the small dashboard widget?

tia: happy to. i'll prototype a widget and link it in the PR.

oncall-lead: run a 2-week pilot after PR merged. we'll review in a 30-min retro at the end.

rita: plan: PR by tomorrow EOD. if no objections in 24h we'll merge and start pilot.

omar: no objections here.

ops-bot: reminder: `@ops-bot help` for integrations and `@ops-bot preview <ticket-id>` before scheduling.

rita: thanks team  goal is fewer orphaned tickets and faster detection of repeat failure modes.
